name: com.cap.proto
description: Auto-generated C# protobuf bindings from cap-spec/proto/cap/v0/*.proto (Phase 1 path-tracking refactor SSOT). Imports Google.Protobuf at runtime; install the NuGet 'Google.Protobuf' package via NuGet for Unity (https://github.com/GlitchEnzo/NuGetForUnity) before this package compiles. Sync .cs files from ../../../cap/cap-spec/gen/csharp/ after every 'buf generate'; see Runtime/README.md for the rsync step.
